steps.instruction: Do not change anything. Button 4 must still be Mouse Function > Back; leave the existing AB macro and Button 5 untouched.
Assign the existing AB, Play Once, 20 ms macro to Button 4 once. Do not edit or rerecord the macro. If NGENUITY changes another button automatically, stop the series after this capture and report it.
Restore Button 4 to Mouse Function > Back once. Do not change another control.
Repeat: assign the same existing AB, Play Once, 20 ms macro to Button 4 once, without editing the macro.
Restore Button 4 to Mouse Function > Back once. Finish with Button 4 on Back.
